capabilities: Opens notes and folders in external code editors
Adds editor entries to the right-click context menu
Adds command-palette commands to open the current file
Groups editors under one menu entry
disambiguation: Despite the generic name, it does not edit notes; it only launches external code editors from the file explorer or tab context menu.
extras: Reload the plugin after enabling an editor to refresh its command-palette commands.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open a note or its folder in an external code editor.
